item.title: Beartooth’s Caleb Shomo Comes Out as Gay, Wife Responds After 14-Year Marriage
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in music. Today, we're talking about Caleb Shomo, the frontman of rock/metalcore band Beartooth. In a personal and emotional Instagram post, Caleb has come out as gay.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Caleb, who's 33, wrote that he felt compelled to share this part of his life after speculation surrounding his personal life. He expressed that being a proudly gay man is something he's been navigating for a while now, and it's been a difficult journey.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Beartooth's music]
Host: As the lead singer and multi-instrumentalist of Beartooth, Caleb has been married to his wife, Fleur, for 14 years. However, following his announcement, Fleur shared her own statement on Instagram, expressing support for Caleb while also confirming that they are no longer together.
[Soft music continues]
Host: Caleb's journey to self-discovery is deeply connected to his music. He wrote that he's been using his albums to explore his feelings, from his religious upbringing to depression and self-loathing. His upcoming album, Pure Ecstasy, is scheduled for release on August 28th, and he's promised to express himself wholeheartedly and honestly in his music.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Beartooth's upcoming album]
Host: Caleb's story is a powerful reminder of the importance of being true to oneself. We appreciate his courage in sharing his personal journey, and we look forward to hearing more from him and Beartooth in the future.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. If you want to stay up-to-date on the latest music news and trends, be sure to follow us on social media. Until next time, goodbye!
